mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qs__auth__token (token_digest, account_id, token_type, refresh_type, expires_at, scene_id, client_ip, user_agent, revoked, created_by, updated_by, session_id) VALUES (#{tokenDigest}, #{accountId}, #{tokenType}, #{refreshType}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{sceneId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{clientIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userAgent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{revoked,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{createdBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{updatedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, CAST(#{sessionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid))
mapper.select: SELECT id, token_digest, account_id, token_type, refresh_type, expires_at, scene_id, client_ip, user_agent, revoked, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, version, session_id::text AS session_id FROM qs__auth__token WHERE token_digest = #{digest}
mapper.update: UPDATE qs__auth__token SET revoked = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked = FALSE
UPDATE qs__auth__token SET revoked = TRUE WHERE session_id = CAST(#{sessionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND revoked = FALSE
UPDATE qs__auth__token SET revoked = TRUE WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND revoked = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM qs__auth__token WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND revoked = FALSE AND expires_at > #{now}
